detail.longDescription: In addition to real-time multiplayer collaboration, your markdown notes in a synced graph in EtherPK - https://app.etherpk.com now keep a version history for every page and journal entry. It also keeps the pages, journal entries and files you delete, so you can restore them if needed. Versioning is an especially important piece of functionality along side AI agent editing or your notes. While versioning is a useful feature for human editing, it becomes more important when AI Agents have the capability to make broad changes at speed. EtherPK has recently added additional AI integration features, such as MCP Server and Headless Client with improved access to Tasks and Kanban boards in your graph, and also Agent Chat for talking to agents using context from your notes.
